population: All 32 PR46 development inputs and independent requests retained. Four singleton core cases, nine diagnostics, 13 cold mask/parity/exact-repeat series, six separate physical-phase cases; one new assessment boundary case. No holdout; no new inference rules.

deliveries.single_summary: One applicable checked SDK packet, independent source/request, cold check, export/explain and registered applications. Raw direct41 is a separate proof-only row.
deliveries.consumer_service: One SDK batch or one first-query SDK packet plus all independent requests. Receiver cold-checks once and independently assesses every requested consumer. Both may answer future supported consumers. One assess result is not a standalone proof.
deliveries.independent_certificates: Every consumer gets its own singleton SDK packet and request, independently checkable without any other packet; compare each_default and each_ordinary. No derived lemma or semantic cache shared across calls. Request order, all packet bytes, first-call preparation, every built-in check charged.
deliveries.local_phase: Unchanged six local cases and four phase routes; never compared to signed PR41.

routes.sdk_direct: PR45 direct_cache batch build; ordinary plus reuse, not plain PR41
routes.sdk_ordinary: PR41 ordinary then PR45 from_certificate(source_query); same SDK capabilities
routes.once_default: PR45 no_lemmas for first request, then receiver check+assess all requests
routes.once_ordinary: PR41 ordinary plus from_certificate for first request, then receiver check+assess all requests
routes.each_default: Independent PR45 no_lemmas singleton build for each consumer
routes.each_ordinary: Independent PR41 ordinary plus from_certificate for each consumer

measurement.order: Fixed registered cases. Rotate arms by case_index+trial and reverse odd trials. Serial timing in each environment. CI shards partition cases only; no pooling machines or Python versions.
measurement.audit: One fresh common call-trace child; retain existing sys.setprofile budgets and execution guards. Never run with tracemalloc.
measurement.memory: One separate fresh tracemalloc child; Python peak, not RSS. No PR47 tracer. Exact canonical delivery/result match.
measurement.timing: Seven fresh children without PR47 tracer/tracemalloc; intrinsic instrumentation retained, instrumented development latency. Include native proof, adapter, all built-in checks and delivery encoding. Cold receiver check, service assess, export/explain and 64 application sequences separately measured.
measurement.cost: Primary lifecycle = build + cold check + all registered consumer assessments + one export/explain per packet. Apply is additional separate scenario. Whole child process overhead shown separately. Failed work included.
measurement.aggregation: All samples, median/min/max. Per family and width and delivery. No universal threshold or population speedup claim; packet size is total independent bytes, no free dedup.

failure_policy: Every scheduled attempt recorded; no retry inside run. Missing audit still gets an explicit failed checker attempt. Interrupted parent leaves checkpoint and manifest. Unexpected result, timeout, corrupted evidence or identity drift fails engineering acceptance; an economic loss does not.
trust: Fresh checker blocks search imports and positive full-source evaluation. Replays all produced intermediate obligations and exact E/E+ scopes. Concrete refutations checked by old verifier. Missing proofs only produce explicitly nonsemantic unsupported/resource-budget diagnostics.

factors: ordinary/query x no_lemmas/reuse with identical native policy, caches and packaging
PR52_plan.controls: For each delivery choose the lowest full median qualifying simple control over the complete registered workload, not fastest trial. Candidate controls: sdk_ordinary singleton, once_ordinary/once_default service, each_ordinary/each_default standalone. Publish the chosen baseline after PR47 before PR48/52 tuning; retain all other rows.
PR52_plan.practical_gate: At least 20% reduction in median full lifecycle and at least 1 ms absolute at singleton or 10 ms at series N>=4; candidate maximum must be below reference minimum on each claimed workload. No correctness/coverage loss and no >10% Python-peak regression without separate explicit tradeoff. If noisy/inconclusive, no positive gate; new preregistered run. Gate is an engineering criterion for this corpus, not market inference.
PR52_plan.fallback: Prefer simplest eligible path. F1 remains open. A negative result ends one optimization cycle rather than deleting workloads.

preservation: All accepted PR46 files byte/mode identical except current-research workflow wiring and additive SUITES registry. New roadmap added without rewriting history. No algorithms/default changes.
